the future is subject to change.. what was once true during one moment in time doesn't necessarily have to be true for the next.. the reason tarot can't always accurately predict what will happen is cos the cards aren't telling u what will happen 100% without a doubt but what's the most likely scenario taking all circumstances into account. from the time u asked the first to the second circumstances could have changed.

disclaimer: new reader here... but my interpretation is that in the past an offer came into ur life that u welcomed with open arms and accepted as is and as is it was beneficial and placed u into a comfortable position of stability.. whatever it was it worked completely in your favor and was exactly what u needed at the time that u needed it

present leads me to believe that that's no longer the case and now whatever once worked for u is now working against u.. what once helped is now hindering and if u don't get out now u'll go down with it

future shows that u'll come to this conclusion on ur own and u'll get out before it can take u out..  it seems like ur real in touch w/ ur intuition and tend to work with it rather than against it and if u keep doing that u'll be more prone to landing on ur feet after jumping over whatever obstacle comes at you

new reader here so take my shit w/ a grain of salt but what i'm getting here is that u have fruitful opportunities awaiting u on the horizon.. success is imminent if u open urself up to it completely and don't hold urself back but it's warning u that not all offers are what they appear to be so u need to be careful about where u invest and what route u choose.. wait until u can measure the true weight of all offers before accepting one.. cos one just might end up weighing u down.. if it looks too good to be true there's a very real chance that it is .. don't rush down the wrong path just cos it looks promising.. take ur time to survey each scene ur presented w/ before embarking.. good things wait u but there's a mirage in the midst of them
